newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat, price spread narrower.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat, price spread narrower.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed unchanged at 476.25/476.60 per dollar Monday as demand for foreign currency was matched by supply, traders said.
"There was sufficient currency supply and the Central Bank has not had to sell many dollars," one said.
While trading was busier than on Friday, the currency market remained broadly stable, traders said.
No large fluctuations in the exchange rate are expected for coming sessions, they added.
